description: Protocol 2. Allow at most 52000 characters AND UTF-8 bytes across authored text. The complete rendered comment has a 60000 character AND byte safety bound, including controller metadata; this is not a preferred length or quality score.

reasoning.description: Concise basis for the outcome; clean reviews need no invented finding.

scope.description: Task contract and relevant boundaries examined; separate inspected and executed work.

location.description: Precise file/line or boundary; empty if not applicable.

explanation.description: Trigger and consequence; Markdown paragraphs, lists and code are welcome.

evidence.description: Supporting source or reproduction and result; distinguish execution from inspection.

resolution.description: Optional suggestion; use an empty string when no particular fix is justified.

verification.description: Checks/probes actually run, commands and outcomes; attribute CI/author evidence and explain relevant checks not run.

risks.description: Uncertainty, nonblocking concerns and deferred work with owner/reference when known; state none when applicable.

observations.description: Optional Markdown discussion, titled subsections, tradeoffs or diagrams; identify observations outside agreed scope. Use an empty string when absent.
